# Archival Dispatch: 25 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Chicken Man, Seeing Ear Theater, Sound Off, George Bruce's Air Stories, and Hank Williams

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Chicken Man, Dick Orkin, Seeing Ear Theater, Brian Smith, Sound Off, Johnny Mercer, Boots Barnett, George Bruce Air Stories, Hank Williams, Hadacol, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 67 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 67 resolves and dates 25 historical radio broadcasts spanning 1960s satirical superhero serials, late-90s digital audio drama productions, WWII Armed Forces Radio Service swing parades, early 1930s aviation serials, and Hank Williams' immortal Hadacol medicine show performances: 6 hilarious adventures of Dick Orkin's ***Chicken Man*** (WCFL Chicago, 1966, starring Benton Harbor as the feathered crime-fighter), 6 full audio productions from the Sci-Fi Channel's pioneering audio drama showcase ***Seeing Ear Theater*** (1999, including original plays and sci-fi disaster dramas), 6 Armed Forces Radio Service broadcast transcriptions of ***Sound Off*** (1944, featuring Johnny Mercer, Boots Barnett, Bill Goodwin, and Harry Von Zell), 5 early aviation chapters from ***George Bruce's Air Stories*** (1932), and 2 legendary 1949 Nashville studio sessions from Hank Williams and the Drifting Cowboys on ***The Health and Happiness Show***.
